topic: Day 1 — carousel — You are not behind, you are just early

slides.text: You are measuring yourself against a schedule nobody wrote down.

You saw four people your age do a thing.
That became the average in your head.
The real spread is [decades] wide. You just never see the other end of it.
Nobody posts the year they spent figuring it out.
You are not late. You are [early], and it is uncomfortable.

caption:
The timeline you feel late against was never a timeline. It was four examples and a feeling.

Follow for one of these a day.
